executiveSummary: The checkpoint in the repository is a 49,920-step zero-padded smoke-test model that does not contain non-zero weights for role-feature indices (115-126). The evaluation pipeline correctly caught and rejected this model, gracefully routing browser and ladder evaluations to baseline fallbacks. A real training run (>=200k steps) under the 127-dim schema is required for genuine policy certification.

criteria.name: Checkpoint & Schema Contract Compatibility
criteria.evidence: CHECKPOINT REJECTED: All 768 role-feature weights (indices 115..126) are exact zeros. This indicates a zero-padded placeholder/smoke-test model rather than a genuinely trained role-aware policy.

criteria.name: Beat Random Baseline
criteria.evidence: MAPPO win rate (30.0%) vs Random (0.0%). Reward: 0.636 vs 0.037.

criteria.name: Competitive with Tactical Rule-Based Baseline
criteria.evidence: MAPPO win rate (30.0%) vs Rule-Based Med (30.0%). Goal diff: 0.30 vs 0.30.

criteria.name: Held-Out Generalization Retention
criteria.evidence: Train win rate: 10.0% | Held-out test win rate: 23.3% | Transfer retention: 233.3% (Gap: -13.3%).

criteria.name: Opponent Robustness & Anti-Exploitation
criteria.evidence: Easy Opponent Win Rate: 20.0% | Hard Opponent Win Rate: 20.0%.

criteria.name: Role Feature Conditioning Sensitivity
criteria.evidence: Standard 127-dim Win Rate: 25.0% | Zero-Role Ablated Win Rate: 25.0%.
